tutorial.say: Cells joined by a dashed fence are a chain. All the cells of a chain are always the same: either all of them are bombs, or none is.

tutorial.play: Try it: mark one cell of the three-cell chain as a bomb. They all change together!

tutorial.say: Chains give you free information. This 0 sees the two cells of the other chain. It says there are no bombs around it, so they are safe - and one of them would have been enough to know.
So a chain behaves like a single big cell: find out one of its cells and you know them all.

tutorial.play: Your turn! The board is cleared again. Find all the bombs.
